flow-seam.blurb: one act leaves fast on an axis with motion blur, a frame of empty ground, the next act arrives on the same axis and direction while the ground changes colour

sources.note: editor window exits left, 'MADERA understands' enters from the right, word by word
tagline exits left word by word, product card enters from the right, ground darkens
card exits left over a red blurred-photo ground, ground fades to light grey, 'find' enters from the right
tagline exits up, ground turns olive, a tilted window rises from the bottom
window exits up, ground returns to light grey, a shape rises from the bottom

slots.at: seconds: the first frame of empty ground
slots.ground: [outgoing ground id, incoming ground id], optional

axis.note: x flows right to left, y flows bottom to top; madera changes axis once per film

gap.note: empty ground measured 0.05 to 0.2 across the five seams

stagger.note: words of an entering line lag each other; expand.mjs does not yet split a text layer into words, see recipes/README.md

exitPx.note: distance the outgoing layer rushes before `at`

enterPx.note: distance the incoming layer travels to arrive at 0

driftPx.note: small anticipation pull the wrong way before the rush
